answer: A new identity spends its first 4 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 48% of full weight. Because the juniper weight is recomputed from the prism history each close, the spiral audit shows the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm therefore buys partial influence at full price for every alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. That is 17 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
